publishes: Maven Central app.revenuedot.purchases:purchases, purchases-ui, purchases-store-amazon, purchases-store-galaxy, purchases-bom, … (same artifact ids, Kotlin packages stay com.revenuecat.purchases.*)

rules.title: RevenueDot Android SDK
rules.description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's Android SDK, pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Add `implementation("{{mavenGroup}}:purchases:<version>")` from Maven Central, plus `{{mavenGroup}}:purchases-ui` for paywalls. The artifact ids are the same as RevenueCat's.
Kotlin packages stay `com.revenuecat.purchases.*`, so imports such as `import com.revenuecat.purchases.Purchases` do not change.
RevenueDot Cloud ({{apiHost}}) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, set `Purchases.proxyURL = URL("https://revenuedot.example.com")` before `Purchases.configure`.
Pass the app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard (it starts with goog_) to `PurchasesConfiguration.Builder`.

rules.note: main API, codegen client (/v2), test-only force-failure URL

rules.replace:
val hasProxyURL: Boolean = proxyURL != null

    // RevenueDot: diagnostics, paywall events and ad events honour proxyURL, like the main API does.
    val diagnosticsBaseURL: URL = proxyURL ?: diagnosticsURL
    val paywallEventsBaseURL: URL = proxyURL ?: paywallEventsURL
    val adEventsBaseURL: URL = proxyURL ?: adEventsURL

rules.note: unit tests assert the default hosts the fork changes
embedded primary and backup API sources

rules.find:
@Test
    fun `embedded api defaults fall back to backup when primary unhealthy`()
rules.done: RevenueDot: the embedded primary and backup sources are the same host

rules.replace:
every { fallbackBaseURLs } returns emptyList()
        every { store } returns Store.PLAY_STORE
        every { diagnosticsBaseURL } returns AppConfig.diagnosticsURL // RevenueDot: diagnostics honour proxyURL
    }
rules.note: the mocked AppConfig needs the property the diagnostics patch reads
the Gradle plugin marker is published as <plugin id>:<plugin id>.gradle.plugin, so the id must sit in our Maven Central namespace
functional test applies the plugin by id

rules.find: The plugin ID is `com.revenuecat.purchases.codegen` and the artifact is `com.revenuecat.purchases:purchases-codegen-plugin`
rules.replace: The plugin ID is `{{mavenGroup}}.codegen` and the artifact is `{{mavenGroup}}:purchases-codegen-plugin`

rules.title: RevenueDot Android SDK
install: implementation("{{mavenGroup}}:purchases-ui:{{version}}")   // only if you use RevenueCat UI
Kotlin packages stay `com.revenuecat.purchases.*`, so imports do not change.

code: // Self-hosted server only: RevenueDot Cloud ({{apiHost}}) is the default.
Purchases.configure(PurchasesConfiguration.Builder(this, "goog_...").build())   // the app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard

rules.configureNote: This fork also sends diagnostics, paywall events and ad events to `proxyURL`.

checks.name: gradle
checks.note: compiles the patched SDK (main and unit-test sources) with the renamed Maven coordinates; CI also runs the unit tests
checks.run: J=${JAVA17_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17}; A=${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/share/android-commandlinetools}; if [ -x "$J/bin/java" ] && [ -d "$A/platforms" ]; then JAVA_HOME=$J ANDROID_HOME=$A ./gradlew -q --no-daemon -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx3g :purchases:compileDefaultsDebugUnitTestKotlin; else echo 'SKIPPED: needs JDK 17 (JAVA17_HOME) and the Android SDK (ANDROID_HOME)'; fi
